notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build year, builder or original design date for the Steamboat Hill tower, so the story leaves them out. A web search snippet claimed a 1935 build, 1972 bids and a 1999 removal, but no page read confirmed those claims, so they are not used. Height conflict is unresolved: the Farris 1959 survey note gives 110 feet overall, while the compilation's table and description give 100 feet. The Farris story (data/stories/us-mn-farris.md) cites only the Hubbard County PDF and does not mention the Farris footing photograph in the 2025 compilation; an editor may want to add it there.
